**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

We are looking for an Applied Science Manager to build and lead Minerva's first Risk Science team in Bengaluru. This is a hands-on role: you will collaborate with scientists in the US to set the scientific bar and advance how we detect and respond to risk across KDP and Kindle Unlimited.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Hire, develop, and retain a high-performing team of applied scientists across levels, and set its practices for experimentation, evaluation, reviews, publishing, and patents.

  

* Push the quality of production risk models higher: set the standard for how model performance is measured, and lead the deep-dive science that turns model behavior into better detection.

  

* Develop new and improved detection models for fraud, abuse, copyright infringement, and harmful content, using NLP, computer vision, LLMs, and behavioral and graph-based modeling.

  

* Partner with engineering, product, policy, and investigation teams in the US and India to turn findings into fixes, and present options, risks, and tradeoffs to senior leaders.

  

* Work with the US science team to divide ownership clearly and share methods across Minerva.

  
About the team  
Kindle Direct Publishing (KDP) has empowered a new wave of self-motivated creators, tearing down barriers that once blocked writers from reaching readers. Minerva is the science and analytics organization for Amazon's Books business. We build systems for content understanding, author marketing and discovery, fraud and abuse prevention, and content risk, and we optimize manufacturing, fulfillment, and quality for Print On Demand (POD). We have mature areas and green-field opportunities, with engineering, business intelligence, and data engineering support across our areas. We are now building science teams in Bengaluru that work closely with our scientists in the US. Risk Science, a team within Minerva, keeps fraud, abuse, copyright infringement, and harmful content out of the Books catalog and programs such as Kindle Unlimited, using text, image, and behavioral data.

------------------------

* 3+ years of scientists or machine learning engineers management experience
* PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application experience
* Excellent communication skills, capable of discussing technical details with a variety of audiences and influencing decision-making processes.
* Experience writing, reviewing, and testing production code in Python or a related language
* Experience shipping machine learning, NLP, or computer vision models to production and maintaining their quality after launch

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience leading teams in the areas of fraud detection, abuse prevention, and content risk management within a digital or e-commerce environment.
* Experience with model monitoring, data drift detection, calibration, or causal analysis of model behavior
* Experience with graph-based ML, behavioral modeling, or real-time detection
* Experience with LLMs, fine-tuning, embeddings, or multimodal models
* Experience building a new team, including hiring across several levels
* PhD in computer science, machine learning, statistics, or a related quantitative field, or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed venues (for example KDD, NeurIPS, ICML, ACL, CVPR) or patents
* Experience leading teams that build with AI coding agents, with guardrails such as tests, automated review, and verifiable done criteria

Job Description: Content & Script Writer

**Company:** Skin Theta Global Pvt. Ltd.  
**Brand:** SAEMORA

About Skin Theta Global Pvt. Ltd.

Skin Theta Global Pvt. Ltd. is a next-generation skincare company driven by innovation, research, and design excellence. Rooted in advanced cosmetic science and inspired by global beauty standards, we create high-performance skincare solutions that combine functionality with refined aesthetics.

Our brand philosophy is built on precision, minimalism, and elevated design, bringing together science, creativity, and technology to deliver a premium skincare experience.

Through our brand SAEMORA, we aim to make skincare more informed, engaging, and accessible through thoughtful products and compelling brand communication.

About the Role

We are looking for a creative, curious, and detail-oriented **Content & Script Writer** who can transform ideas, product benefits, skincare science, and consumer insights into compelling content and engaging video scripts.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of storytelling, audience psychology, digital content formats, and current social media trends. You should be able to develop creative concepts, write attention-grabbing hooks, build engaging narratives, and simplify skincare-related information into clear, credible, and relatable communication.

This role will primarily focus on writing scripts for Instagram Reels, short-form videos, educational content, product explainers, influencer collaborations, brand campaigns, and other digital formats.

We are looking for someone who can balance creativity with research, understand what captures audience attention, and develop content that strengthens brand awareness, builds consumer trust, and drives engagement.

Key Responsibilities1. Script Writing for Short-Form Videos

* Write engaging scripts for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and other short-form video platforms.
* Develop compelling hooks that capture attention within the first few seconds.
* Create scripts with clear storytelling, strong narrative flow, and effective calls to action.
* Write scripts in different formats, including educational, conversational, entertaining, problem-solution, myth-busting, and product-focused videos.
* Develop multiple script variations to test different hooks, angles, messaging styles, and storytelling approaches.
* Structure scripts with appropriate dialogue, voiceovers, visual cues, on-screen text, and scene transitions.
* Adapt scripts to different video durations and audience attention spans.
* Collaborate with the production team to ensure scripts translate effectively into engaging visual content.

2. Skincare Research & Educational Content

* Research skincare ingredients, formulations, routines, skin concerns, and emerging beauty trends.
* Translate complex skincare science into simple, engaging, and consumer-friendly language.
* Develop educational scripts on ingredients, product usage, skincare routines, common misconceptions, and frequently asked consumer questions.
* Research topics such as skin hydration, skin barrier care, sunscreen, exfoliation, acne-prone skin, pigmentation, and other relevant skincare subjects.
* Ensure content is factually accurate, credible, and aligned with approved product information.
* Verify claims using reliable sources and coordinate with the relevant internal team when technical clarification is required.
* Avoid exaggerated, misleading, or medically unsupported skincare claims.

3. Product Content & Brand Storytelling

* Develop scripts that communicate product features, key ingredients, benefits, usage instructions, and differentiating factors.
* Translate product specifications into meaningful consumer benefits.
* Create compelling product introduction videos, explainers, demonstrations, and launch content.
* Develop narratives that communicate the brand's philosophy, product development approach, quality standards, and design principles.
* Create content that builds consumer trust while maintaining a premium, science-led brand voice.
* Ensure consistent messaging across product pages, video scripts, campaign materials, and other consumer-facing content.

4. Creative Concept Development

* Brainstorm original content ideas for Reels, Shorts, product videos, and digital campaigns.
* Develop creative concepts based on audience questions, consumer pain points, skincare trends, and product positioning.
* Identify relatable situations, storytelling angles, and creative formats that make skincare content more engaging.
* Develop recurring content series and distinctive storytelling formats for the brand.
* Convert trending topics into relevant, brand-appropriate content ideas without blindly following every trend.
* Create content around skincare myths, common mistakes, routines, ingredient education, frequently asked questions, and consumer experiences.
* Prepare creative briefs and content outlines for shoots and campaigns.

5. Research, Trends & Audience Insights

* Monitor social media trends, emerging content formats, creator styles, and developments in the beauty and skincare industry.
* Research competitor content to identify opportunities for differentiation and stronger storytelling.
* Study audience comments, questions, reviews, and feedback to discover relevant content topics.
* Analyse successful content formats and identify the storytelling elements that may have contributed to their performance.
* Maintain a structured repository of content ideas, references, hooks, scripts, and creative inspiration.
* Continuously explore new approaches to improve content relevance, originality, and audience retention.

6. Influencer & Creator Script Writing

* Develop briefs and scripts for influencers, content creators, and brand collaborators.
* Create clear talking points that communicate product benefits while allowing creators to maintain their natural style.
* Adapt scripts to different creator personalities, audiences, and content formats.
* Develop concepts for product demonstrations, testimonials, unboxing videos, routines, and educational collaborations.
* Ensure that creator content remains aligned with brand guidelines, approved claims, and campaign objectives.

7. Campaign & Marketing Copywriting

* Write headlines, captions, taglines, hooks, calls to action, and short-form promotional copy.
* Contribute creative ideas and messaging for product launches, seasonal campaigns, and brand-building initiatives.
* Develop copy for advertisements, landing pages, product descriptions, and promotional materials when required.
* Adapt messaging for organic social media, paid campaigns, website content, and other digital channels.
* Maintain consistency in brand tone, messaging, terminology, and communication standards.
* Collaborate with the marketing team to ensure content supports campaign objectives.

8. Script Development & Production Coordination

* Prepare structured scripts with scene-by-scene breakdowns, dialogue, voiceovers, visual references, and on-screen text.
* Develop shot suggestions and visual storytelling cues to help production teams execute the concept.
* Participate in brainstorming sessions, shoot planning, and creative reviews.
* Work closely with videographers, editors, designers, marketers, and on-camera talent.
* Review edited videos to ensure that the final content communicates the intended message accurately.
* Incorporate feedback and revise scripts based on creative direction, production requirements, and campaign needs.
* Maintain an organised record of script versions, approvals, and content deliverables.

RequirementsExperience & Qualifications

* 1-3 years of experience in content writing, script writing, copywriting, digital content creation, or a related field.
* A portfolio demonstrating original writing, short-form video scripts, storytelling, or digital campaign content.
* Experience writing scripts for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, or similar video formats is preferred.
* Experience in skincare, beauty, wellness, lifestyle, D2C, or e-commerce brands will be an advantage.
* A degree or qualification in English, Journalism, Mass Communication, Advertising, Marketing, or a related field is preferred but not mandatory for candidates with a strong portfolio.

Skills & Competencies

* Excellent writing, editing, proofreading, and storytelling skills.
* Ability to write attention-grabbing hooks and engaging scripts.
* Strong understanding of audience psychology, narrative structure, and short-form video formats.
* Ability to simplify technical information without compromising accuracy.
* Strong research skills and attention to detail.
* Understanding of social media trends, creator content, and digital storytelling.
* Ability to develop original ideas rather than simply reproduce trending formats.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments, feedback cycles, and deadlines.
* Openness to feedback and willingness to refine ideas based on creative direction.
* Interest in skincare science, beauty, consumer behaviour, branding, and design.

Tools & Platforms

Familiarity with the following tools and platforms will be an advantage:

* Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts
* Google Docs and Google Sheets
* Google Drive
* Canva
* CapCut and InShot
* ChatGPT or other AI-assisted research and writing tools
* Basic video editing and script-formatting tools
* Online research tools and social media trend discovery platforms

AI tools may be used to support brainstorming and research, but the candidate must demonstrate independent thinking, fact-checking, original writing, and editorial judgement.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who thinks beyond writing words and understands how to turn an idea into a compelling story.

Someone who constantly asks:

* What will make the audience stop scrolling?
* How can we communicate this idea in a simple and memorable way?
* What makes this product relevant to the consumer?
* How can we make skincare education interesting without compromising scientific accuracy?
* What storytelling angle will make our content distinctive?
* How can we turn a good idea into a script that works on camera?

The ideal candidate will be curious, proactive, research-oriented, creatively ambitious, and comfortable taking ownership of a script from initial idea to final production.

What You'll Gain

* The opportunity to shape the content voice of an emerging premium skincare brand.
* Creative ownership in developing original scripts, video concepts, and campaigns.
* Exposure to skincare science, product development, brand positioning, and consumer marketing.
* Hands-on experience with video production, influencer collaborations, and digital campaigns.
* Opportunities to experiment with storytelling formats and creative approaches.
* Collaboration with marketing, design, and production teams.
* A growth pathway into senior content, creative strategy, brand communication, or creative direction roles.

Work Environment

* Full-time, on-site role based in JP Nagar, 8th Phase, Bangalore.
* Collaborative and creativity-driven work culture.
* Fast-paced environment with opportunities to contribute original ideas.
* Strong emphasis on research, accuracy, quality, and attention to detail.
* Opportunity to work closely with the founding and marketing teams.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their resume and portfolio of relevant writing samples, video scripts, or content projects at **skintheta@gmail.com**.

For enquiries, contact **+91 7996301234**.

Please include at least two or three examples of short-form video scripts or content pieces that demonstrate your storytelling ability, creativity, and writing style.

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

**About Digit**

At Digit, our mission is to Make Insurance Simple. We use technology to make insurance easier to understand, buy and claim. Our general insurance products cover motor, health, travel, home and business needs. Simplicity, transparency and customer experience guide how we develop our products and communicate with customers.

**About the role**

You will own content strategy and editorial delivery for assigned insurance categories on godigit.com. You will turn customer questions, product expertise and approved data into useful content that helps people understand insurance and make informed decisions. You will set editorial priorities, guide writers and partners, and work with SEO, product and analytics teams to improve discovery, trust and business outcomes. This is a hands-on role requiring strong writing and editing skills alongside strategic judgement.

**Responsibilities**

Content strategy and planning

* Define audiences, customer needs, core messages and content priorities across insurance education, comparison, purchase and servicing journeys. Align the plan with product and marketing goals.

* Own the editorial roadmap and calendar for product pages, supporting articles, guides and tools. Create briefs that specify audience, intent, angle, evidence, format, owners and delivery dates.

* Audit the content inventory with SEO and product teams. Decide what to create, improve, consolidate or retire, resolving gaps, duplication, outdated information and weak relevance.

Research and original insights

* Work with Product, Claims, Data Science and experts to develop original reports, practical examples and thought leadership from approved information. Interview specialists and identify insights that add value beyond generic summaries.

* Research using primary sources, approved policy documents and relevant public data. Validate facts and comparisons, and record sources, dates, definitions, data periods and limitations for review.

Editorial quality and team leadership

* Write and edit priority content, including product pages, comparisons, FAQs, explainers and tool copy. Make complex insurance concepts clear while retaining material conditions, exclusions and qualifications.

* Set and maintain standards for Digit’s voice, terminology, readability, sourcing and authorship. Arrange expert review for financial and health topics, and check that titles, tables and examples accurately reflect the evidence.

SEO and AI search visibility

* Use findings from Google AI Overviews, AI Mode and assistant audits to improve content coverage and factual representation. Work with SEO on AEO and GEO experiments and evaluate results against reliable guidance.

Content formats and production

Measurement and optimisation

* Use GA4, Search Console, dashboards and customer feedback to assess pages and content clusters. Test topics, formats and content journeys, explain measurement limits and recommend the next priorities.

* Proven ownership of a content strategy, editorial roadmap and delivery programme for a large website or competitive product category.

* Excellent English writing and editing skills, with a portfolio showing original research, clear explanations and strong editorial judgement.

* Ability to translate complex financial, health or other technical information for a general audience while preserving accuracy and important qualifications.

* Strong research and interviewing skills, including evaluating primary sources, interpreting data and working with subject-matter experts.

description:
**About Vista Equity Partners**



Vista Equity Partners is a leading global investment firm focused exclusively on enterprise software, data, and technology\-enabled businesses. With over $100B in assets under management and a portfolio of 90\+ software product companies worldwide, Vista accelerates growth through operational excellence, shared expertise, and long\-term partnership. In India, Vista’s presence continues to expand with 45\+ portfolio companies employing more than 17,000 professionals across technology, product, customer success, and operations — reinforcing India’s strategic role as a hub of innovation and talent within the Vista ecosystem.



Through its Agentic AI Factory, Vista is embedding Generative AI across its global portfolio — enabling companies to integrate intelligent, responsible AI into products, operations, and decision\-making. This initiative is strengthened through portfolio\-wide learning programs, leadership workshops, and AI hackathons that foster innovation, build fluency, and accelerate practical AI adoption across teams.


**About Amtech**



Amtech is a leading provider of enterprise software solutions for the packaging, printing, and manufacturing industries. Our integrated systems streamline order management, production planning, scheduling, inventory, and business analytics — empowering customers to drive efficiency, reduce costs, and improve operational performance. With a strong commitment to innovation and customer success, Amtech delivers reliable technology backed by deep industry expertise.



With Vista’s investment and strategic guidance, we combine the agility of a growing technology organization with the scale, stability, and career mobility of a global software ecosystem.


**Our Employee Value Proposition**



At Amtech, our people are our greatest differentiator. We create an environment where you can:


**Purpose**



Shape the future of manufacturing and supply chain operations by delivering mission\-critical enterprise software used by industry\-leading organizations.


**Growth**



Access continuous learning, leadership development, and cross\-portfolio opportunities through Vista’s global network — accelerating both technical and managerial career paths.


**Culture**



Work in a collaborative, transparent, and people\-first environment where values, accountability, and integrity guide every decision.


**Innovation**



Engage with cutting\-edge technologies, including AI\-driven automation, and contribute to modernizing financial systems and operational processes across the business.

  


**Role Description**



We are looking for a Senior Documentation Specialist to own the customer\-facing documentation experience for Amtech's ERP and MES products. You will be the person who turns complex manufacturing workflows — estimating a corrugated order, scheduling a corrugator run, tracking WIP through conversion, closing the loop to invoicing — into documentation our customers actually use and trust.



This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership role. You will write and maintain user guides, in\-application help, release notes, and how\-to content; you will also set the standards, style, and structure that all Amtech product documentation follows. You will work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Implementation, and Support, and you will be expected to learn our customers' world — the plant floor, the order lifecycle, the way a packaging manufacturer actually operates.


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**


**Documentation ownership**


* Plan, write, edit, and maintain the full library of customer\-facing documentation for Amtech's ERP and MES products, including user guides, configuration and administration guides, quick\-reference materials, and in\-application help.
* Own the release notes process end to end — partner with Product and Engineering each release cycle to capture what changed, why it matters, and what customers need to do about it.
* Audit existing content on a regular cadence; retire what is stale, rewrite what is unclear, and close gaps that show up in support tickets and customer feedback.

**Standards and structure**


* Establish and enforce a documentation style guide, terminology standards, and content templates so that everything Amtech publishes reads as one voice.
* Define and improve the information architecture of the help center — how content is organized, searched, versioned, and navigated across product lines and releases.
* Administer and improve the documentation toolchain and publishing workflow; recommend improvements to tooling, single\-sourcing, and reuse.

**Collaboration and subject\-matter expertise**


* Partner with Product Managers, developers, QA, implementation consultants, and support engineers to gather source material, validate technical accuracy, and get ahead of upcoming releases.
* Use the product yourself. Build a working understanding of packaging manufacturing operations and of how Amtech customers configure and run the system in production.
* Participate in release readiness and go\-to\-market planning to ensure documentation ships alongside the software, not after it.
* Partner with Product and Engineering to document AI\-enabled capabilities as they ship, making new intelligence features understandable and trustworthy to customers.

**Quality and measurement**


* Define quality standards for documentation and review the work of other contributors — writers, product managers, and engineers who contribute content.
* Track documentation effectiveness using search analytics, page performance, support ticket deflection, and direct customer feedback; use that data to prioritize the roadmap.

**SKILLS \& QUALIFICATIONS**


**Required Qualification**


* 6\+ years of professional experience in technical writing, product documentation, or technical communications, with a substantial portion producing customer\-facing content for a software product.
* Demonstrated experience documenting enterprise software — ERP, MES, supply chain, or comparable operational systems.
* A portfolio of published documentation you can walk us through, showing how you explain complex, multi\-step workflows to a non\-technical operational audience.
* The ability to take an engineer's explanation of a feature and turn it into instructions a plant scheduler can follow on the first read — precise, plain, and logically sequenced, with no step assumed.
* A rigorous eye for editing: you cut what is unnecessary, catch inconsistent terminology, and hold a large content library to one standard.
* Proven experience owning documentation standards — style guides, templates, terminology, and information architecture — not just executing against someone else's.
* Hands\-on experience with a component content management or help\-authoring platform — MadCap Flare, Paligo, Heretto, Document360, Zendesk Guide, Confluence, or comparable — including publishing, versioning, and single\-sourcing across product lines.
* Proficiency with screen capture and image editing tools for clear, consistent visual documentation.
* Comfort working directly with software: navigating a complex application, reading a spec, testing a workflow, and validating your own instructions against the product.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent releases and competing priorities with minimal supervision.
* Bachelor's degree in Technical Communication, English, Engineering, Information Science, or a related field — or equivalent professional experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**


* Direct experience documenting ERP and/or MES platforms, especially in a manufacturing environment.
* Familiarity with packaging, corrugated, folding carton, label, or other discrete or process manufacturing operations.
* Working knowledge of manufacturing and business concepts such as specifications, routings, scheduling, WIP tracking, inventory, order\-to\-cash, and shop\-floor data collection.
* Experience with docs\-as\-code workflows (Markdown, Git, static site generators) or structured authoring (DITA, XML).
* Experience producing video walkthroughs, product tours, or e\-learning content alongside written docs.
* Exposure to API or integration documentation.
* Comfort using AI tools to accelerate drafting, editing, and content audits — with the judgment to know where human verification is non\-negotiable.
* Interest in structuring documentation for machine consumption as well as human readers, so content can reliably feed in\-product AI assistants and search.
* Experience supporting a global customer base, including localization or translation workflows.
* Background in a SaaS or hybrid on\-premise/cloud software environment with a regular release cadence.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**



Hybrid role based out of Amtech's Bengaluru office, with roughly three days per week on\-site, working closely with Product, Engineering, and Support colleagues across our India and North America teams. Occasional travel for customer site visits, industry events, or company meetings.


**Why Join Amtech**



At Amtech, you will drive meaningful financial impact in a growing enterprise software organization while benefiting from Vista’s world\-class ecosystem. You’ll collaborate with talented peers, leverage cross\-portfolio learning programs, and help shape the future of Amtech’s financial operations and systems. Build your career with Amtech — backed by the strength, scale, and innovation culture of Vista.
